U.S. forces struck two launchers after spotting the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps preparing to fire rockets carrying sea mines into the Strait of Hormuz, CNN reported, citing CENTCOM spokesperson Capt.

The IRGC said it launched missile and drone strikes on two U.S. air bases in Jordan in retaliation for the U.S. attack on Larak Island, state broadcaster IRIB reported.
Jordanian authorities said its air defenses intercepted and destroyed eight missiles that entered the country’s airspace, with no reported casualties or property damage.
Sunday’s strikes marked the first U.S. attacks on Iranian targets since late July.
IRGC Calls US Strike On Larak Island ‘Deadly Mistake’
The IRGC had vowed retaliation earlier Sunday after accusing the "US-Zionist enemy" of striking Larak Island, saying the attack caused casualties among Iranian forces and civilians, the report noted.
In a statement carried by state broadcaster IRIB, an IRGC spokesperson called the strike a "strategic and deadly mistake" by the Trump administration.
